schema: triattn_cells/v1: triangle-attention rows (implementations) and measured cells. A CELL key is '<cc>|<dtype>|D<head_dim>|H<heads>|N<=<size>|<direction>' (size = the smallest measured token count at or above the call's; direction 'fwd' = inference; a call that needs a backward reaches only rows with backward=true). Per cell: 'fast' = the measured fastest row inside the tolerance class, 'fast_order' = every row that beat the stock op, fastest first (a kit's prefer= list is matched against it), 'fast_per_stack' = the fastest row per measured software stack, 'exact' = the fastest row whose output is bitwise the stock op's, named wherever it measured at or above x1.00 (parity or better, median over stacks; 'exact_x_per_stack' shows each stack; a 'parity' entry flags a winner inside the x0.97-1.03 noise band); the stock op itself by name where no exact row reached x1.00, 'x_stock' = stock ms / row ms (median over stacks), 'ms' = per-row per-stack medians, 'refused' = rows that named a refusal on that card, 'ceiling_40gb' = the named memory ceiling of a 40 GB card. Launch settings: a Triton row runs its OWN cell table for the device (fpf_triatt_k2b K2B_CELLS.json by compute capability; flash_triattn _CONFIG_TABLE_BY_CC by '<cc>|<triton major.minor>'); 'config_words' below are opt-in named settings a kit may pass as config=.
op: out[b,n,h,i,:] = softmax_j(scale*q[b,n,h,i,:].k[b,n,h,j,:] + bias[b,0,h,i,j] (-1e9 where mask[b,n,0,0,j] is False)) @ v[b,n,h,j,:]; q/k/v [B,N,H,S,D], bias [B,1,H,S,S] fp32 shared over the N rows, mask [B,N,1,1,S] bool, out in q.dtype (the cuequivariance triangle_attention calling convention). Starting vs ending node is the caller's transpose: one direction at this level. A fully-masked row yields the uniform average of v. The attention rows never see the pair width c: a c=64 template pair stack with (H,D)=(4,32) is the D32|H4 cell, (2,32) the D32|H2 cell, (4,16) the D16|H4 cell, (4,64) the D64|H4 cell.
default_rule: select(word=<row>) serves exactly that row with the row's own launch cell for the device -- what a kit that binds that row today already runs, byte for byte (k2b == fpf_triatt_k2b.attn_k2b, flash == flash_triattn.flash_triangle_attention, cueq == the kit's stock call). The measured winners are OPT-IN: a kit reaches them only by passing a tier word (word='fast' | 'exact', optionally narrowed by prefer=(row, ...)) or by naming the row. A row that cannot serve the call refuses BY NAME (Refusal.kind, .row, .fallback names the cell's row to bind instead); nothing substitutes a row silently.
exact_rule: 'exact' names an exact-class row wherever it measured >= x1.00 over the stock op (speed >= 0 at the measured sizes: median over stacks; per-stack values under exact_x_per_stack); a named winner inside x0.97-1.03 carries a 'parity' flag; otherwise -- and wherever a cell names it -- the stock op is the exact tier's row by name (exact by definition)
tie_rule: rows whose x_stock medians are within 3 % of each other are ordered by the number of measured stacks each was fastest on (fast_per_stack), then k2b before k2 before flash

tiers.fast: the cell's 'fast' row (first of fast_order admitted in this process; prefer= narrows the candidates, order kept from prefer)
tiers.exact: the cell's 'exact' row (bitwise the stock op's output); 'cueq' names the stock op itself where no exact row measured >= x1.00

fp32.tf32: k2b / k2 / flash fp32 inputs: tensor-float-32 products (the rows' default; rel-RMS vs fp64 1.4e-3)
fp32.tf32x3: flash row, input_precision='tf32x3': split-float products, rel-RMS vs fp64 6e-7..1.5e-4 -- at or below the stock op's own fp32 path (1.4e-4..7e-4), x1.15-1.6 over it
fp32.ieee: k2b / flash input_precision='ieee': never a default (x0.16-0.43 of the stock op)

words.per_call_note: cells 9.0|bf16|D32|H4|N<=800 / 1200 / 1536 carry `per_call`: host-inclusive per-call numbers on two software stacks (torch 2.7.1+cu128 and 2.13.0+cu130) for the per-row-mask and key-padding forms -- the package stays ahead of cuda_sm90a end to end (x1.29-1.39 per-row masks, x1.05-1.14 padding) and its host cost per call through the face (86-119 us) is below cuda_sm90a's (114-136 us); select() / describe() / admits() are memoised (a kit adapter that called them per call paid 0.52-0.62 ms per call for the package row, 0.19-0.21 ms for cuda_sm90a, before this version; ~1 us now)
words.in_model_note: cells may carry `in_model`: kit-reported in-model verdicts at that cell (record only). Where a kit's trunk measures one word at every N ahead of a per-N split (9.0|bf16|D32|H4|N<=511 keypad: -5.5 % trunk time with triattn_native@v10 everywhere), the kit binds one word; the op-level order of the cell is unchanged and says which row is faster per call

cc80_padding.what: cc 8.0, bf16, pair bias + ONE key-padding length L = S*(1-p): the package's Triton member vs k2b vs the stock op as a function of the padded fraction p (A100-SXM4-80GB:torch2.13.0+cu130/triton3.7.1/cueq0.11.1/race-cc80-forms)
cc80_padding.finding: two effects, both in the padded-token form only: k2b's masked path costs it +19-26 % as soon as any key is padded (1.18 -> 1.42 ms @512, 5.96 -> 7.50 @1024, 46.7 -> 57.9 @2048) while the package's member skips dead key tiles (time ~ live fraction); so at p = 0 the incumbent keeps (k2b x1.02-1.14 faster at <= 1024, parity x1.04 at 2048) and from p = 1/8 the package leads: x1.14 / 1.37 / 1.46 @512 / 1024 / 2048, x1.24 / 1.57 / 1.69 at p = 1/4, x1.47 / 2.18 / 2.45 at p = 1/2 (D16 / D64 @1024: x0.97 / 0.97 at p = 0, x1.74 / 1.67 at p = 1/4). A call with no padded keys is the bias_only form by definition; kits pass form='keypad' for calls whose key mask pads >= 1/8 of the keys.
cc80_padding.generation: 10 (the plain Triton member generation 10 served cc 8.0 with; kept as the record of that member -- generation 11 serves the sm_80 extension, forms records per cell)

cc80_flips.what: tier-word flips on cc 8.0 (generation 11's sm_80 member, generation-11 race): per cell x call form x layout, the incumbent word (k2b / its tuned cell / k2 / cueq) -> triattn_native@v11 where the same-box record shows the package's median >= 5 % below the best incumbent's with disjoint IQRs (DEFAULT-FLIP); the un-hinted tier word follows the mask_bias (per-row ragged) contiguous record at the bucket's deciding size; parity keeps the incumbent (listed in the cell's forms record, not here)

exact_vouch.what: an exact-class vouch (bitwise vs the stock op) holds only on the (cc, torch+cuda, stock-library version) stack it was measured on; exact cells carry `vouched_on` = {row: [stack keys]}; select(word='exact', exact_stack=<key>) / triangle_attention(word='exact') serve the exact row only on a listed key, else the tier passes it over (stock op; reason names `exact_vouch_not_recorded:<key>`) and a named exact row word refuses by name with fallback the stock op; key format '<cc>|torch<torch.__version__>|cueq<cuequivariance_torch version>'

evidence.8.0|torch2.7.1+cu126|cueq0.10.0: exact_headsplit byte-identical to the stock op on A100-SXM4-80GB, torch 2.7.1+cu126 / triton 3.3.1 / cuequivariance 0.10.0 / python 3.11, at H12 and H2, D32: the same kit's det-1 byte checks (40/40 output files across its releases, 400-1340-token inputs; 15/15 variable-length members 2026-09-11/12). Recorded on the H12 / H2 cells and the row.

device_tags.what: a vouch key may carry a DEVICE TAG as a 4th field ('<cc>|torch<v>|cueq<v>|<tag>'): the untagged key holds for the column's reference device only (the device the vouch was measured on); every other device of the same cc runs under its own tagged key and an exact-class row serves there only where that tagged key is listed (measured bitwise on that device) -- else the exact tier names the library op by name. exact_stack_key() appends the tag from the CUDA device name; no device / a stubbed torch: no tag.
device_tags.other_devices: a device not listed gets its sanitized name as the tag (matches no vouch: the library op by name until measured)

measured.A100-40GB: exact_headsplit bitwise at 37 keys (tagged vouch added per cell)

exact_vouch.ops_build_suffix: a row whose record declares `ops_builds` is vouched under keys with the ops build appended to the library field ('<cc>|torch<v>|cueq<v>+cu13'); kernels.triattn.vouch_keys() forms the spellings (the live build when an ops distribution is visible, else every declared build), vouched() matches them; rows without `ops_builds` keep the three-field key

words.first_call_note: rows carry `first_call`: first / second served-call wall ms per fresh process by mode (direct | direct_warm | resolved) on the reference stack. QoL rule: no runtime tuning or building -- sealed rows load prebuilt binaries and pass their byte gate when select() first RESOLVES them (activation), Triton rows JIT once per cache dir (warm() moves it to activation).

peak_audit.what: big / peak audit of the triangle-attention tier words (audit after an engine's BIG line grew its device peak): per cell `mem_delta_mib` = steady-state peak of the tier-word winner minus k2b's in the SAME process (flash == k2b bytes in every record), `big_note`; a cell whose winner costs more than max(8 MiB, 2 %) above k2b would split its big word to the lower-peak row (none does)

cc_9_0.measured: D16 H4 and D32 H4: S 1024 / 1536 / 2048 x dense (bias_only) + keypad x contiguous + strided (sm_90 peak pass, H100 80GB HBM3, ref-2.13 stack, 24 records) + S 256 ... 1216 contiguous from the generation-11 race's H100 A/B (19 records)
cc_9_0.result: triattn_native@v11 (== @v10 bytes-out) allocates LESS than k2b / flash everywhere: D16 -16 / -36 / -64 MiB at S 1024 / 1536 / 2048, D32 -6 / -14 / -27 MiB (both forms, both layouts); cuda_sm90a another 2-5 MiB below the package; no big split
cc_9_0.unmeasured: none of the asked keys; other H (2/8/12/16) and D64 on 9.0 not asked (k2b / flash write only the output there too; the package's extra over the output is its fp32 row statistics, D-independent: ~ N*H*S*4 bytes)

cc_8_0.measured: every cc-8.0 bf16 cell x bias_only / keypad / padrows / mask_bias x contiguous + strided at the bucket sizes (generation-11 confirm race, A100-SXM4-80GB, ref-2.13 stack, 228 records) + the 2560 bucket (H4 / H8 / H2 / H12 x three forms, contiguous, exact-debt measurement) + the beyond-2048 buckets (3072 / 4096 / 6144 where measured; winner minus k2b per form)
cc_8_0.result: triattn_native@v11 (the sm_80 member) allocates at or below k2b / flash on all 228 records (delta -96 ... +0.9 MiB, median -7.7 MiB); no big split

peak_audit.noise_rule: beyond noise = more than max(8 MiB, 2 % of k2b's peak) above k2b (allocator block rounding is 2 MiB; repeated records agree to 0.5 MiB)
peak_audit.caveat: op-level steady-state high-water marks above resident inputs around one solo call after warm-up (allocator cache emptied first); they bound what a tier-word flip can add per call (at S=2048 D32 H4 the whole op peaks ~1.1 GiB above its inputs on either card), not an engine's end-to-end reserved-memory growth across many calls (allocator caching / fragmentation, first-call extension loads and other flipped ops are outside this table)

words.fast_by_lib_note: cells may carry `fast_by_lib` = {<stock-library version key, e.g. cueq0.11.1>: {fast, fast_order, column}} where two measured columns of the same cc disagree because the library op itself changed speed between library versions (cc 10.0: library 0.10.0 ships an sm_100 kernel that leads the portable rows on a kit's stack; with 0.11.1 the portable rows lead in the sweep): select(..., lib=<key>) / triangle_attention (which passes the process's own library version) resolve fast / big by that entry; without `lib` the cell-level words (the stack) answer

buckets.rule: the smallest listed size >= n_tokens among the sizes the (cc, dtype, head_dim, heads) group measured; above the group's largest its largest cell serves with measured=false (the table's largest bucket is N<=6144)
buckets.heads_rule: an unlisted head count takes the nearest listed head count at the same dtype and head_dim (largest below, else smallest above) with heads_measured=false

triattn_native.routes: the package's own router, keyed by device cc.  cc 9.0 (generation 10's table name for name; `cuda/` sources byte-identical, `cuda_b/` + `cuda_c/` = generation 10 + the dead-row early exit (fully-masked query rows skipped; live AND dead rows byte-identical), the 17 cc-9.0 test vectors identical): bf16 D32 S<512 contiguous -> its Gluon kernel; S<512 strided -> extension triattn_sm90_ext; 512<=S<=3072 and S>4096 -> triattn_m1_ext; 3072<S<=4096 -> triattn_mw_ext_g3x4; fp16 or D16 -> Gluon / Triton; D64 / D128 or S_q != S_kv -> its Triton kernel.  cc 8.0 (generation 11): bf16 D16 / D32 / D64 with S_q == S_kv, any S, contiguous or strided views -> extension triattn_sm80_ext (the sm_80 member: mma.sync m16n8k16 / ldmatrix / cp.async ring, exact fp32 bias staging, 64-bit addressing, deterministic, graph-capturable, dead-row early exit); fp16 / D128 / S_q != S_kv -> its plain Triton member (unmeasured); other devices refused by name ('cc X.Y: no member of v11 for this device')
triattn_native.abi: prebuilt per package key 'torch<version>-<python soabi>' under triattn_native/pkg/<pkg>/triattn_pkg/prebuilt/<key>/ (one .so + .json record per extension: the sm_90a three + triattn_sm80_ext; the record's so_sha256 / source_sha256 are verified and the package's byte-gate vectors OF THE DEVICE'S cc re-run at install: the 17 cc-9.0 cases gate the sm_90a extensions, the a80_* cases gate triattn_sm80_ext); a key or extension without a prebuilt is refused by name (no_prebuilt:<pkg>@<key>[:<ext>]) -> fallback cuda_sm90a then the cell's order on 9.0, the cell's next row (k2b) on 8.0
triattn_native.numerics: tolerance class vs the stock op: online softmax in fp32, bf16 P for the PV product; rel-RMS vs fp64 stated per cell beside cueq's (excess_rms = row / cueq); the sm_80 member: the same class (fp32 online softmax in exp2 units, exact fp32 bias staging, bf16 P for the PV product), excess-RMS vs cueq 1.09-1.12 per 8.0 cell
triattn_native.cc_8_0: generation 11: the sm_80 CUDA member (extension triattn_sm80_ext, prebuilt per key like the sm_90a three) serves bf16 D16 / D32 / D64 with S_q == S_kv at any S / B / H / N, contiguous or strided views, on exactly cc 8.0 (8.6 / 8.9 refused by name) through the row words `triattn_native` / `triattn_native@v11` AND, from the generation-11 race's same-box confirm race (words.cc80_flips), through the tier words fast / big on every cc-8.0 bf16 cell where it won beyond noise in the form the call has (35 of 36 cells at the ragged form; per form and layout in forms.<form>.<layout>); a stack without the key's prebuilt is passed over by name (no_prebuilt:v11@<key>) to the cell's next word (k2b / its tuned cell); fp16 / D128 / S_q != S_kv -> the plain Triton member by row word only (unmeasured); `triattn_native@v10` is refused by name on 8.0 (generation 10 served 8.0 with its Triton member: its 0.5.73.1 form records stay nested as forms.<form>.<layout>.gen10_member, unreachable by word while v11 is active)

Evidence per key: the package's certified prebuilt binaries (sm_90 / sm_80) bit-identical to the library op across its width suite on that (card, library, build), plus this tree's own grid probes and byte-identical end-to-end predictions on the H100 keys; the four cu12 keys on H200 (9.0|torch2.10.0+cu128|cueq0.10.0+cu12|H200, 9.0|torch2.13.0+cu130|cueq0.11.1+cu12|H200, 9.0|torch2.7.1+cu126|cueq0.10.0+cu12|H200, 9.0|torch2.7.1+cu128|cueq0.10.0+cu12|H200) rest on the package's lean gate (canary + partial width + end-to-end) and are provisional in the package's own book-keeping -- they serve; a failed first-call self-check refuses the row by name for the process. The EXACT word names the row in the 34 cc-9.0 cells and the 32 cc-8.0 cells `bf16|D32|H2..H12|N<=...<=4096|fwd` on those keys and passes it over by name (`exact_vouch_not_recorded:<stack>`) on every other stack (A100 40GB, other torch / library pairs); outside a proven cell of the package (S<=100 under the default environment, S>4160, H16, other builds) the row refuses by name per call and the stock op serves.
